purpose: Require every CEW agent run to finish one coherent authorized work item or stop with a machine-readable blocker while retaining execution-profile and resume provenance.

COMPLETE_PASS_WITH_REVIEW: mechanical and technical work is complete
the remaining review does not permit canonical promotion until approved
BLOCKED_HUMAN_DECISION: all technically executable work is complete
at least two materially different valid semantic/engineering choices remain
evidence and consequences for each choice are supplied
BLOCKED_EVIDENCE: required authoritative evidence is absent or ineligible
the missing evidence is identified precisely
the agent did not substitute an inference as evidence
BLOCKED_CANONICAL_GATE: the requested action would cross an explicit CEW promotion boundary
the exact blocking gate is identified
FAIL_STOP: a required gate failed after in-scope repair attempts
failure evidence and reproducible diagnostic are supplied

self_repair_policy.loop: execute -> inspect failure -> repair in scope -> rerun -> complete
do_not_escalate_for: schema mismatch repairable inside the tranche

forbidden_completion_claims: technical PASS used as substitute for required visual/engineering review
future work promised without executing available in-scope steps
